blocks.title: Pay Attention About the Immoral Woman

texts.NIV84: My son, pay attention to my wisdom, listen well to my words of insight,
texts.KJV: My son, attend unto my wisdom, and bow thine ear to my understanding:
texts.NKJV:
My son, pay attention to my wisdom;
Lend your ear to my understanding,
texts.DRB: My son, attend to my wisdom, and incline thy ear to my prudence.

texts.NIV84: that you may maintain discretion and your lips may preserve knowledge.
texts.KJV: That thou mayest regard discretion, and that thy lips may keep knowledge.
texts.NKJV:
That you may preserve discretion,
And your lips may keep knowledge.
texts.DRB: That thou mayst keep thoughts, and thy lips may preserve instruction. Mind not the deceit of a woman.

texts.NIV84: For the lips of an adulteress drip honey, and her speech is smoother than oil;
texts.KJV: For the lips of a strange woman drop as an honeycomb, and her mouth is smoother than oil:
texts.NKJV:
For the lips of an immoral woman drip honey,
And her mouth is smoother than oil;
texts.DRB: For the lips of a harlot are like a honeycomb dropping, and her throat is smoother than oil.

texts.NIV84: but in the end she is bitter as gall, sharp as a double-edged sword.
texts.KJV: But her end is bitter as wormwood, sharp as a two-edged sword.
texts.NKJV:
But in the end she is bitter as wormwood,
Sharp as a two-edged sword.
texts.DRB: But her end is bitter as wormwood, and sharp as a two-edged sword.

texts.NIV84: Her feet go down to death; her steps lead straight to the grave.
texts.KJV: Her feet go down to death; her steps take hold on hell.
texts.NKJV:
Her feet go down to death,
Her steps lay hold of hell.
texts.DRB: Her feet go down into death, and her steps go in as far as hell.

texts.NIV84: She gives no thought to the way of life; her paths are crooked, but she knows it not.
texts.KJV: Lest thou shouldest ponder the path of life, her ways are moveable, that thou canst not know them.
texts.DRB: They walk not by the path of life, her steps are wandering, and unaccountable.

texts.NIV84: Now then, my sons, listen to me; do not turn aside from what I say.
texts.KJV: Hear me now therefore, O ye children, and depart not from the words of my mouth.
texts.NKJV:
Therefore hear me now, my children,
And do not depart from the words of my mouth.
texts.DRB: Now therefore, my son, hear me, and depart not from the words of my mouth.

texts.NIV84: Keep to a path far from her, do not go near the door of her house,
texts.KJV: Remove thy way far from her, and come not nigh the door of her house:
texts.NKJV:
Remove your way far from her,
And do not go near the door of her house,
texts.DRB: Remove thy way far from her, and come not nigh the doors of her house.

texts.NIV84: lest you give your best strength to others and your years to one who is cruel,
texts.KJV: Lest thou give thine honour unto others, and thy years unto the cruel:
texts.NKJV:
Lest you give your honor to others,
And your years to the cruel one;
texts.DRB: Give not thy honour to strangers, and thy years to the cruel.

texts.NIV84: lest strangers feast on your wealth and your toil enrich another man's house.
texts.KJV: Lest strangers be filled with thy wealth; and thy labours be in the house of a stranger;
texts.NKJV:
Lest aliens be filled with your wealth,
And your labors go to the house of a foreigner;
texts.DRB: Lest strangers be filled with thy strength, and thy labours be in another man's house,

texts.NIV84: At the end of your life you will groan, when your flesh and body are spent.
texts.KJV: And thou mourn at the last, when thy flesh and thy body are consumed,
texts.NKJV:
And you mourn at last,
When your flesh and your body are consumed,
texts.DRB: And thou mourn it the last, when thou shalt have spent thy flesh and thy body, and say:

texts.NIV84: You will say, "How I hated discipline! How my heart spurned correction!
texts.KJV: And say, How have I hated instruction, and my heart despised reproof;
texts.NKJV:
And say:
“How I have hated instruction,
And my heart despised correction!
texts.DRB: Why have I hated instruction, and my heart consented not to reproof,

texts.NIV84: I would not obey my teachers or listen to my instructors.
texts.KJV: And have not obeyed the voice of my teachers, nor inclined mine ear to them that instructed me!
texts.NKJV:
I have not obeyed the voice of my teachers,
Nor inclined my ear to those who instructed me!
texts.DRB: And have not heard the voice of them that taught me, and have not in- dined my ear to masters?

texts.NIV84: I have come to the brink of utter ruin in the midst of the whole assembly."
texts.KJV: I was almost in all evil in the midst of the congregation and assembly.
texts.NKJV:
I was on the verge of total ruin,
In the midst of the assembly and congregation.”
texts.DRB: I have almost been in all evil, in the midst of the church and of the congregation.

blocks.title: The Eyes of the Lord See The Ways of Man

texts.NIV84: Drink water from your own cistern, running water from your own well.
texts.KJV: Drink waters out of thine own cistern, and running waters out of thine own well.
texts.NKJV:
Drink water from your own cistern,
And running water from your own well.
texts.DRB: Drink water out of thy own cistern, and the streams of thy own well:

texts.NIV84: Should your springs overflow in the streets, your streams of water in the public squares?
texts.KJV: Let thy fountains be dispersed abroad, and rivers of waters in the streets.
texts.NKJV:
Should your fountains be dispersed abroad,
Streams of water in the streets?
texts.DRB: Let thy fountains be conveyed abroad, and in the streets divide thy waters.

texts.NIV84: Let them be yours alone, never to be shared with strangers.
texts.KJV: Let them be only thine own, and not strangers' with thee.
texts.NKJV:
Let them be only your own,
And not for strangers with you.
texts.DRB: Keep them to thyself alone, neither let strangers be partakers with thee.

texts.NIV84: May your fountain be blessed, and may you rejoice in the wife of your youth.
texts.KJV: Let thy fountain be blessed: and rejoice with the wife of thy youth.
texts.NKJV:
Let your fountain be blessed,
And rejoice with the wife of your youth.
texts.DRB: Let thy vein be blessed, and rejoice with the wife of thy youth:

texts.NIV84: A loving doe, a graceful deer- may her breasts satisfy you always, may you ever be captivated by her love.
texts.KJV: Let her be as the loving hind and pleasant roe; let her breasts satisfy thee at all times; and be thou ravished always with her love.
texts.DRB: Let her be thy dearest hind, and most agreeable fawn: let her breasts inebriate thee at all times; he thou delighted continually with her love.

texts.NIV84: Why be captivated, my son, by an adulteress? Why embrace the bosom of another man's wife?
texts.KJV: And why wilt thou, my son, be ravished with a strange woman, and embrace the bosom of a stranger?
texts.NKJV:
For why should you, my son, be enraptured by an immoral woman,
And be embraced in the arms of a seductress?
texts.DRB: Why art thou seduced, my son, by a strange woman, and art cherished in the bosom of another ?

texts.NIV84: For a man's ways are in full view of the LORD, and he examines all his paths.
texts.KJV: For the ways of man are before the eyes of the Lord, and he pondereth all his goings.
texts.NKJV:
For the ways of man are before the eyes of the Lord,
And He ponders all his paths.
texts.DRB: The Lord beholdeth the ways of man, and considereth all his steps.

texts.NIV84: The evil deeds of a wicked man ensnare him; the cords of his sin hold him fast.
texts.KJV: His own iniquities shall take the wicked himself, and he shall be holden with the cords of his sins.
texts.NKJV:
His own iniquities entrap the wicked man,
And he is caught in the cords of his sin.
texts.DRB: His own iniquities catch the wicked, and he is fast bound with the ropes of his own sins.

texts.NIV84: He will die for lack of discipline, led astray by his own great folly.
texts.KJV: He shall die without instruction; and in the greatness of his folly he shall go astray.
texts.NKJV:
He shall die for lack of instruction,
And in the greatness of his folly he shall go astray.
texts.DRB: He shall die, because he hath not received instruction, and in the multitude of his folly he shall be deceived.
